title.en: Write the equation of an AM wave
Find modulation index, sidebands and bandwidth
Calculate power in an AM wave

say.en: On an oscilloscope an AM wave looks like a fast carrier inside a slowly changing outline. That outline, the envelope, is an exact copy of the message. In this lesson: Write the equation of an AM wave.
Find modulation index, sidebands and bandwidth.
Calculate power in an AM wave.

body.en: If the carrier is $v_c = V_c\sin\omega_c t$ and the message is $v_m = V_m\sin\omega_m t$, the *AM wave* is $v = V_c(1 + m\sin\omega_m t)\sin\omega_c t$, where the modulation index $m = V_m/V_c$. From the waveform, $m = (V_{max} - V_{min})/(V_{max} + V_{min})$. For distortion-free AM, $m \le 1$; $m > 1$ is over-modulation and distorts the envelope.

points.en: m = Vm/Vc (often given as a percentage)

narration.en: The AM wave is Vc times one plus m sine omega-m t, times sine omega-c t. The modulation index m equals Vm by Vc and must not exceed one.
narration.kn: AM ತರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ m = Vm/Vc. m ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಅತಿ-ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್ ಆಗಿ ವಿಕೃತಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

blocks.formula: v = V_c\,(1 + m\sin\omega_m t)\sin\omega_c t, \qquad m = \frac{V_{max}-V_{min}}{V_{max}+V_{min}}

say.en: The AM wave is Vc times one plus m sine omega-m t, times sine omega-c t. The modulation index m equals Vm by Vc and must not exceed one. m equals Vm over Vc (often given as a percentage).
say.kn: AM ತರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ m equals Vm over Vc. m ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಅತಿ-ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್ ಆಗಿ ವಿಕೃತಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: m equals (Vmax - Vmin)/Vmax plus Vmin.
m is greater than 1: over-modulation, distortion.

title.en: On the board: The AM wave

say.en: Here is the message, a 1 kilohertz tone, and the carrier, a much faster 20 kilohertz wave.
In AM the carrier amplitude rises and falls with the message. The outline, called the envelope, has the shape of the message.
The modulation index m is the message amplitude over the carrier amplitude, here 0.5. Above 1, the envelope distorts.
Look at the spectrum: the carrier in the middle, with two side frequencies at fc minus fm and fc plus fm. The bandwidth is 2 fm.
Total power is Pc times 1 plus m squared over 2. With 500 watts and m 0.6, the total is 590 watts, and only 90 watts carry the message.
On the board: The AM wave.

narration.en: The carrier amplitude follows the message: v = Vc(1 + m sin ωm t) sin ωc t, with modulation index m = Vm/Vc. The spectrum has the carrier and two side frequencies fc ± fm, each of amplitude mVc/2, so the bandwidth is 2fm. Above m = 1 the wave is over-modulated and distorted.
narration.kn: ವಾಹಕದ ವೈಶಾಲ್ಯ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: v = Vc(1 + m sin ωm t) sin ωc t, m = Vm/Vc. ವರ್ಣಪಟಲದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಹಕ ಮತ್ತು fc ± fm ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳು; ಪಟ್ಟಿಅಗಲ 2fm. m > 1 ಅತಿ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಷನ್.

say.en: The carrier amplitude follows the message: v equals Vc1 plus m sin omega m t sin omega c t, with modulation index m equals Vm over Vc. The spectrum has the carrier and two side frequencies fc plus or minus fm, each of amplitude mVc/2, so the bandwidth is 2fm. Above m equals 1 the wave is over-modulated and distorted.
say.kn: ವಾಹಕದ ವೈಶಾಲ್ಯ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: v equals Vc1 plus m sin omega m t sin omega c t, m equals Vm over Vc. ವರ್ಣಪಟಲದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಹಕ ಮತ್ತು fc plus or minus fm ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳು; ಪಟ್ಟಿಅಗಲ 2fm. m is greater than 1 ಅತಿ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಷನ್.

body.en: Expanding the AM equation gives three components: the carrier $f_c$, the upper side frequency $f_c + f_m$ and the lower side frequency $f_c - f_m$, each side frequency with amplitude $mV_c/2$. The bandwidth is $2f_m$. Total power $P_t = P_c(1 + m^2/2)$; the two *sidebands* together carry only $m^2P_c/2$, so even at $m = 1$ only one-third of the power carries information.

points.en: USB = fc + fm, LSB = fc − fm
Pt = Pc(1 + m²/2); each sideband m²Pc/4

narration.en: An AM wave contains the carrier and two sidebands at fc plus and minus fm, so the bandwidth is twice fm. Total power is Pc times one plus m squared by two.
narration.kn: AM ತರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಹಕ ಮತ್ತು fc ± fm ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಸೈಡ್‌ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ. ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ವಿಡ್ತ್ = 2fm. ಒಟ್ಟು ಶಕ್ತಿ Pt = Pc(1 + m²/2).

say.en: An AM wave contains the carrier and two sidebands at fc plus and minus fm, so the bandwidth is twice fm. Total power is Pc times one plus m squared by two. USB equals fc plus fm, LSB equals fc - fm.

problem.en: An AM wave shows Vmax = 12 V and Vmin = 4 V on the CRO. The carrier power is 400 W. Find (a) m, (b) total power, (c) power in each sideband.

steps.en: (c) Each sideband = m²Pc/4 = 0.25 × 400/4 = 25 W (two sidebands = 50 W = 450 − 400).

answer.en: m = 0.5, Pt = 450 W, 25 W per sideband

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An AM wave shows Vmax = 12 V and Vmin = 4 V on the CRO. The carrier power is 400 W. Find (a) m, (b) total power, (c) power in each sideband.

say.en: Let us work this out together. An AM wave shows Vmax equals 12 volts and Vmin equals 4 volts on the CRO. The carrier power is 400 watts. Find a m, b total power, c power in each sideband.
a m equals 12 minus 4/12 plus 4 equals 8 over 16 equals 0.5.
b Pt equals Pc(1 plus m squared/2) equals 400(1 plus 0.25 over 2) equals 400 times 1.125 equals 450 watts.
c Each sideband equals m squaredPc/4 equals 0.25 times 400 over 4 equals 25 watts (two sidebands equals 50 watts equals 450 minus 400).
So the answer is m equals 0.5, Pt equals 450 watts, 25 watts per sideband.

problem.en: A 2 MHz carrier is modulated by audio from 50 Hz to 4 kHz. Find the range of the upper sideband and the bandwidth.

steps.en: USB runs from fc + 50 Hz to fc + 4 kHz = 2.00005 MHz to 2.004 MHz.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A 2 MHz carrier is modulated by audio from 50 Hz to 4 kHz. Find the range of the upper sideband and the bandwidth.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A 2 megahertz carrier is modulated by audio from 50 hertz to 4 kilohertz. Find the range of the upper sideband and the bandwidth.
USB runs from fc plus 50 hertz to fc plus 4 kilohertz equals 2.00005 megahertz to 2.004 megahertz.
Bandwidth equals 2 times fmmax equals 2 times 4 kilohertz equals 8 kilohertz.
So the answer is USB 2.00005-2.004 megahertz; BW equals 8 kilohertz.
